replies.set_design: {"tool":"set_design","arguments":{"base":"exploration","objective":"Run endlessly down a three-lane canyon track, switching lanes, jumping and sliding to dodge obstacles while collecting coins; survive as far as possible before a crash ends the run.","features":["Hook: the runner never stops — speed climbs every 200 m so dodging windows get tighter the longer you survive","Three-lane canyon track with instant lane switching via LEFT/RIGHT or A/D","Low barriers force a SPACE jump, overhead gates force a slide (DOWN/S), and full rock blocks force a lane change","Coin lines and jump arcs raise the score; every coin gives a pickup flash and sound","Crash feedback with hit flash, camera shake and crash sound, then a result screen showing distance and coins with a Restart button","Obstacle patterns spawn in fair, telegraphed sequences with rising density and speed as distance grows","Instructions overlay before Start freezes play; pause menu holds help and restart","Milestone banner every 500 m with a chime to mark progress"],"assets":[],"presentation":{"environment":"desert"},"mechanics":{"outcomes":["lost"],"lives":1}}}
